entry.literal: they shall be glad (+ -m); crocus(?); wilderness; dry land; desert; joy(?) and singing; the Carmel / the orchard land; make firm; stumbling; the hasty of heart; vengeance comes, the recompense of God; the lame; deer; mute; burning heat / mirage; jackals; its resting place; grass / court to reed and papyrus; a raised road and a way; the way of the holiness; and it (is) for them, one walking a way, and fools shall not stray; it shall not be found; and the redeemed shall walk; the ransomed of; gladness and joy
entry.standardEnglish: ASV: 'shall be glad', 'blossom as the rose', 'rejoice even with joy and singing', 'the excellency of Carmel and Sharon', 'confirm the feeble knees', 'them that are of a fearful heart', 'your God will come [with] vengeance, [with] the recompense of God', 'the lame man leap as a hart … the dumb', 'the glowing sand', 'in the habitation of jackals, where they lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes', 'a highway … and a way … The way of holiness … but is shall be for [the redeemed]: the wayfaring men, yea fools, shall not err [therein]', 'they shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk [there]', 'the ransomed of Jehovah', 'gladness and joy'. KJV: 'shall be glad for them', 'dragons', 'for those', 'it shall not be found there'. JPS 1917: 'make firm the tottering knees', 'herds shall lie down, It shall be an enclosure for reeds and rushes', 'for those'. NJPS: 'like a rose' (note 'Lit. "crocus"'), 'It shall also exult and shout', 'The splendor of Carmel and Sharon', 'the anxious of heart', 'Behold your God! Requital is coming', 'Torrid earth', 'The home of jackals, a pasture; The abode [of ostriches], reeds and rushes' (notes 'Meaning of Heb. uncertain; emendation yields "a marsh"'; 'Cf. 34.13'), 'a highway shall appear there … the Sacred Way … But it shall be for them' (notes 'Emendation yields "for His people"'; 'Meaning of Heb. uncertain'), 'These shall not be found there', 'the ransomed of the LORD', 'joy and gladness' (ASV via bible-api.com; JPS 1917 and NJPS (Tanakh: The Holy Scriptures, published by JPS, 1985; not the Gender-Sensitive Edition) via Sefaria API v3; KJV via bible-api.com; all checked 2026-11-26). NRSV 'crocus', 'the Holy Way' and the 'mirage' rendering of šārāḇ: recalled, not verified. 1QIsaᵃ readings from Fred P. Miller's online collation of col. XXVIII (ao.net/~fmoeller), not checked against DJD 32. RSV, ESV and NRSVue 35:7 'the grass shall become reeds and rushes'; ESV 35:8 'the Way of Holiness' (BibleGateway, checked by the Reviewer 2026-11-26).
entry.wohChoice: 35:1 yᵉśuśûm 'shall be glad' (final -m not rendered as a suffix; consonants unchanged); midbār 'wilderness', ṣiyyāh 'the dry land', ʿărāḇāh 'desert' (common noun, as 35:6; 40:3; cf. 33:9; at 43:19-20 the pair is midbār / yᵉšîmôn); ḥăḇaṣṣeleṯ 'the rose' (ASV, JPS 1917, NJPS text; crocus/asphodel identification in commentary). 35:2 'rejoice even with joy and singing' (ASV); hakkarmel 'Carmel', the place name, beside Lebanon and Sharon (against 'the fruitful field' of 10:18; 29:17; 32:15-16, where the context is agricultural); rnn 'sing/singing' through the chapter (35:2, 6, 10). 35:3 'make firm the feeble knees' (JPS 1917 verb, ASV adjective). 35:4 'those who are of a fearful heart'; ASV/JPS 1917 construal 'your God will come with vengeance, with the recompense of God' kept, NJPS exclamation 'Behold your God!' (cf. 40:9) in commentary; 'Be strong, do not fear!' (central al-tira formula entry not applied). 35:6 'the lame … like a deer … the mute' (generic singular without supplied 'man', wave I-4 ruling 13; current English for 'hart', 'dumb'). 35:7 šārāḇ 'the glowing sand' (ASV); tannîm 'jackals' (as 13:22; 43:20; 34:13; KJV 'dragons' = confusion with tannîn); riḇṣāh 'where they lay' (ASV); ḥāṣîr lᵉqāneh wāḡōmeʾ 'grass shall become reeds and rushes' (MT vowels, ḥāṣîr 'grass' with ASV; lᵉ of becoming as in the verse's first two clauses, replacing ASV's 'with'); the JPS 1917/NJPS 'enclosure/abode' reading (cf. 34:13) in commentary. 35:8 maslûl wāḏereḵ 'a highway … and a way' (MT; dittography deletion and NJPS in commentary); dereḵ haqqōḏeš 'the Way of Holiness', capitalised as a called name (cf. 19:18 'the City of Destruction'); wᵉhûʾ-lāmô 'but it shall be for them' (no supplied words; ASV '[the redeemed]', emendation 'for His people' in commentary); hōlēḵ dereḵ waʾĕwîlîm lōʾ yiṯʿû 'the wayfarers, even fools, shall not go astray' (athnach construal; no gendered noun, no supplied 'therein'). 35:9 lōʾ timmāṣēʾ 'they shall not be found there' (ASV plural for the 3fs collective); 'the redeemed shall walk there' (ASV supplied adverb kept). 35:10 pᵉḏûyê YHWH 'the ransomed of YHWH' (central goel-geullah context clause, founder sign-off 2026-11-26); śāśôn wᵉśimḥāh 'gladness and joy' (ASV; śûś/śāśôn = glad/gladness, śimḥāh = joy inside the chapter; stable 22:13 has the reverse order of English nouns, recorded, not changed).
entry.rationale: Each item is a site where the line keeps the Masoretic text and chooses among the renderings of the standard versions; none carries a project reading. (1) The final -m of yᵉśuśûm is not an object suffix in ASV, JPS 1917 or NJPS (KJV 'glad for them' is the exception), and it is usually explained as a dittography of the following m or as an enclitic mem; rendering no suffix changes no consonant. (2) ḥăḇaṣṣeleṯ is a flower of uncertain identity (Song 2:1); 'rose' is the English of ASV, JPS 1917 and the NJPS text, and NJPS itself notes 'Lit. "crocus"', so the line keeps the familiar word and the commentary gives the botany. (3) hakkarmel is 'the fruitful field' in the stable chapters, where it stands beside forest and wilderness; at 35:2 it stands between Lebanon and Sharon, both regions, and every version checked prints 'Carmel'; the article is normal with the mountain (1 Kgs 18:19-20; Amos 1:2), and the same three regions wither at 33:9. (4) At 35:4 the accents allow both the ASV/JPS 1917 construal and the NJPS exclamation; the line keeps the public-domain construal, which needs no change of word order. (5) At 35:7 the noun ḥāṣîr is kept as 'grass' with ASV, but the preposition lᵉ is given the sense 'become' that it has twice earlier in the same verse (laʾăḡam, lᵉmabbûʿê mayim), so the line reads 'grass shall become reeds and rushes', the wording of RSV, ESV and NRSVue (checked by the Reviewer on BibleGateway, 2026-11-26); ASV's 'with' is not the sense lᵉ has elsewhere in this verse. The alternative, ḥāṣîr 'court, abode' as at 34:13 (JPS 1917, NJPS), is recorded in commentary. tannîm 'jackals' matches the stable 13:22 and 43:20. (6) At 35:8 the line follows MT 'a highway … and a way', capitalises the called name 'the Way of Holiness' as 19:18 capitalises 'the City of Destruction', and renders wᵉhûʾ-lāmô 'but it shall be for them' without ASV's supplied '[the redeemed]', which interprets an unclear antecedent; NJPS also prints 'for them'. The athnach on lāmô puts hōlēḵ dereḵ in the last clause, as in ASV, JPS 1917 and NJPS. (7) Modern English replaces ASV's 'confirm' (35:3), 'hart' and 'dumb' (35:6), and the supplied 'man' and 'wayfaring men' are dropped under wave I-4 ruling 13 for generic human nouns. (8) The joy vocabulary follows ASV inside the chapter; the inconsistency with stable 22:13 is recorded and not changed, because no entry fixes the book's joy vocabulary. XXVIII, not DJD 32; lexica, grammars and NRSV not verified.

rationaleAppend: Wave I-5 (Isa 35): the verse the rationale cites is now governed. hăḏar hakkarmel wᵉhaššārôn 'the splendor of Carmel and Sharon' and hăḏar ʾĕlōhênû 'the splendor of our God' stand beside kᵉḇôḏ hallᵉḇānôn 'the glory of Lebanon' and kᵉḇôḏ-YHWH 'the glory of YHWH'. ASV and JPS 1917 have 'excellency' at both hāḏār sites, and NJPS has 'splendor' at both (Sefaria API v3 and bible-api.com, checked 2026-11-26).

Wave I-5 (Isa 35): 35:2 kᵉḇôḏ hallᵉḇānôn 'the glory of Lebanon shall be given to it' (ASV, JPS 1917, NJPS 'glory', checked 2026-11-26). The glory of a region given to the desert stands in the same verse as kᵉḇôḏ-YHWH (central kavod-yhwh), so one English word lets the reader see the repetition of the noun.
Wave I-5 (Isa 35): 35:2 hăḏar ʾĕlōhênû 'the splendor of our God'; 35:4 hinnēh ʾĕlōhêḵem 'Behold, your God' (the same phrase as 40:9).
Wave I-5 (Isa 35): 35:4 gᵉmûl ʾĕlōhîm 'the recompense of God' (absolute ʾĕlōhîm of YHWH; ASV, JPS 1917, NJPS 'God', checked 2026-11-26).

Wave I-5 (Isa 35): the Translator's descriptive title 'Isaiah 35 — The wilderness blossoms, and the redeemed return to Zion by the Way of Holiness' is ratified ('the redeemed' are the gᵉʾûlîm of 35:9, so the title is unaffected by the 35:10 'ransomed' decision). The message of 35:4 is set in quotation marks as embedded speech ('Say to those who are of a fearful heart, "Be strong, do not fear! … save you."'), as NJPS marks it; JPS 1917 quotes only 'Be strong, fear not' (checked 2026-11-26).

Wave I-5 (Isa 35): MT kept throughout. 35:1 the final -m of yᵉśuśûm is not rendered as a suffix (dittography or enclitic mem); no consonant is changed. 35:8 maslûl wāḏereḵ 'a highway … and a way' kept against the proposed deletion of wāḏereḵ as dittography (NJPS omits it, checked) and against the emendation 'for His people' at lāmô (NJPS note, checked). 35:7 MT vowels of ḥāṣîr kept ('grass'); the emendation 'a marsh' (NJPS note) is reported. 1QIsaᵃ variants reported in commentary from Fred P. Miller's online collation of col. XXVIII (ao.net/~fmoeller; not checked against DJD 32), not adopted: 35:2 lᵉḇānôn without the article (35:1-2 written in a compressed correction line); an extra yēlᵉḵû 'they shall go' at the junction of 35:6-7; 35:7 rēḇeṣ without the suffix; 35:8 a doubled šāmmāh; 35:9 bal lōʾ (double negative); 35:10 wᵉnās (singular) for wᵉnāsû.
